TNAU Senior Research Fellow Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the TNAU Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download TNAU Senior Research Fellow Job 2026 Notification PDF

Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for TNAU Senior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for TNAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The post name for the Tamil Nadu Agricultural University Recruitment 2026 is Senior Research Fellow. This is a contractual position.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Senior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Senior Research Fellow position at Tamil Nadu Agricultural University.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Senior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc. (Agri.) in Agrl. Entomology to be eligible for the Senior Research Fellow position.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Senior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Senior Research Fellow post will receive a salary of Rs. 37,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is a Walk-in Interview. No online application is required.

faq.question: Q6. When is the Walk-in Interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview for the Senior Research Fellow position is scheduled for 06 October 2026.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for TNAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, and category certificates (if applicable).

faq.question: Q9. Where is the Walk-in Interview venue?
faq.answer: The venue for the Walk-in Interview is Tamil Nadu Agricultural University, Coimbatore. Specific details will be in the official notification.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The job type for the Senior Research Fellow position at TNAU is contractual.
